messages:
maria: Heads-up — after yesterday's tenant migration, ~10% of users can log in but are missing assigned roles. SSO asserts show no roles claim. Repro steps below. @devin @sam :eyes:

devin: Looking. Which attribute did the mapping change? we only tightened the SAML attribute whitelist during migration.

maria: We restricted whitelist to only `roles` and `email`. Example assertion we received:
```xml
<saml:AttributeStatement>
  <saml:Attribute Name="roles">
    <saml:AttributeValue>viewer</saml:AttributeValue>
  </saml:Attribute>
</saml:AttributeStatement>
```
But our auth logs for affected users show `roles` missing entirely.

sam: Do you have the raw SAML for an affected user? can reproduce locally? also, did Okta JIT mapping previously accept `groups`?

maria: Log snippet from affected login:
```
2026-03-18T18:02:11Z auth INFO user=alice@example.com login_success roles=[] tenant=acme-corp
2026-03-18T18:02:11Z idp DEBUG saml_assertion: attributes={email: 'alice@example.com'}
```
No `roles` present. Alice had roles before migration.

alex: We did remove a legacy fallback during the cleanup step. Some tenants still send `groups` instead of `roles`. The JIT mapper had a `groups->roles` fallback that got removed: `sso_mapper.remove_fallback('groups')`.

devin: So two failure modes: (1) whitelist blocks `groups`, (2) fallback mapping removed. Quick fixes: (A) re-add fallback, (B) expand whitelist to include `groups`, (C) update mapper to accept either and normalize. Which has lowest blast radius?

sam: I'd go with C — update mapper to accept both and normalize into our internal role enum. Deploy small patch + tests. Also add audit logging for any automatic role rehydration so we can track what changed.

maria: This is customer-facing and happening now. Can someone re-enable fallback ASAP to stop the impact?

devin: Re-enabled fallback in okta-proxy config and rolled at 18:25 UTC (config rollback). Confirmed several users regained roles.

audit-bot: audit:role-change 10 events for tenant=acme-corp created_by=system.rollback at=1793156900

alex: Opening PR: `fix(sso): accept groups or roles attribute and preserve JIT fallback` — https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/3212

sam: Add unit tests for SAML attribute permutations and an end-to-end test with an Okta sample assertion. Also add a canary check to migration scripts to detect missing role attributes.

maria: I'll surface affected customer list to CS and offer post-migration checks.

devin: Follow-up action: add telemetry alert if >1% of logins are missing role claims for 5m. I'll draft alert + runbook.

maria: :thumbsup: thanks all. Will close thread after PR merges and postmortem is drafted.
